messages:
Aisha Khan: hi all, Aisha here — just joined Platform this week. Quick mapping question: who should I ask for repo access, who owns model rollout approvals, and who do I page for infra perf problems? trying to build a 'who-to-ask' for my first week.

Priya Gupta: welcome Aisha! repo access -> open #help ticket 'repo access' and cc me. People Ops owns org groups and VPN invites.

Maya Patel: hey Aisha, Platform owns rollout config and dedicated capacity requests. For approvals: Eng-ML signs off on model quality, Eng-Platform on infra config. Use /forms/model-rollout to start.

Liam O'Neill: infra perf problems -> page eng-platform-oncall for perf regressions, eng-sre-oncall for outages. Our usual paging is 10/30 escalation. See runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/rollouts

Aisha Khan: thanks — is there a single doc that lists these contacts, or should I keep my own note?

Priya Gupta: there's a contacts page but it's a little out of date. I can add a quick table to the handbook this week. If you DM me I'll add you as reviewer.

onboard-bot: Reminder: complete 'Platform orientation' and 'Security basics' in 3 days: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding

Aisha Khan: great, I'll DM you Priya and start the model-rollout form for a small test. appreciate it! :smile:
